integrity: The primary source was inspected through its Ma-Minda target construction, endpoint parameter range, and stated Hankel-determinant results. The new radius proof uses the classical parabolic characterization of uniform convexity, exact boundary reduction, a symbolic resultant, and an explicit canonical extremal. A packaged exact-arithmetic checker replays the polynomial elimination and contact certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the exact uniformly convex radius only for the endpoint quadratic target phi(z)=1+z+z^2/2. It does not supply a full parameter formula for 0<=t<1/2, a stability theorem, or k-uniform/spirallike variants.
title: Sharp uniform-convexity radius for the quadratic Ma–Minda endpoint
